# GitHub

> > GitHub is the AI-powered developer platform for version control, collaborative coding, and software development, featuring GitHub Copilot, Actions, Codespaces, and Advanced Security.

GitHub hosts millions of open source repositories and provides integrated tools for code review, CI/CD automation, security analysis with CodeQL, and educational workflows. The platform combines Git-based version control with modern developer tools including AI-assisted coding, cloud development environments, and package management.

## Key Topics

- GitHub Copilot
- GitHub Actions
- GitHub Codespaces
- Git version control
- GitHub Advanced Security
- CodeQL
- Open source
- Code review
- CI/CD automation
- Repository management
- GitHub CLI
- GitHub Packages
- Collaborative coding
- Code security
- Developer tools

## Core Platform

- [GitHub Homepage](https://github.com/): GitHub homepage: AI-powered developer platform with Copilot and Actions
- [GitHub Features](https://github.com/features): GitHub features overview: Copilot, Actions, Codespaces, and Packages
- [GitHub Organization](https://github.com/github): GitHub's official organization profile with 535 open source repositories

## Documentation

- [GitHub Docs](https://docs.github.com/): GitHub documentation hub for developers, admins, and all products
- [Git Basics](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/git-basics): Git setup guide: configure version control for GitHub repositories

## Security & Code Analysis

- [CodeQL](https://codeql.github.com/): CodeQL: semantic code analysis for vulnerability detection and security

## Education

- [GitHub Classroom](https://classroom.github.com/): GitHub Classroom for education: automate assignments and grading
